title: Paper theorem-type definition surface

traversal_policy.roots: Every top-level theorem declared in namespace KFOL.Paper in Paper.lean; traverse its type, never its proof body.
traversal_policy.project_expansion: Recursively traverse declaration types, non-proof definition/opaque bodies, and reachable inductive constructor types in modules KFOL.* or Paper.
traversal_policy.proof_erasure: Lean.Meta.isProof erases proof-valued subterms with local binders in scope, including proof-only helper definitions. Proposition expressions themselves remain: predicates and hypotheses contribute their mathematical definitions.
traversal_policy.inductives: Reachable inductive declarations include their constructors and mutual inductive declarations. Kernel-generated recursors are indexed by their types; their computation rules are supplied by Lean's inductive kernel.
traversal_policy.external_boundary: Record directly referenced external constants and their declared types without unfolding their definitions or traversing the external dependency closure.
traversal_policy.purpose: A reproducible index for reviewing the mathematical meaning of public statements. It does not establish that a definition matches the manuscript, replace human review, or replace the independent source/import/axiom audits.

review_order: Read each public theorem's literal type in Paper.lean and its per-theorem slice below.

Review central KFOL/Definitions files, then the extra semantic definitions reached in algorithm/round/machine files. Source fingerprints and exact declaration edges identify that complete project surface.
Review the imported GameTheory and ComplexityLib/Cslib boundary types separately. External boundary entries are interfaces, not a claim that their full definition closure was audited here.
Use the existing whole-project axiom/import audit for proof dependencies; they are deliberately absent from this report.

    ∀ (out : Fin 3 → Role),
      (∀ (i : Fin 3),
          KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i x)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (out i)) →
        KFOL.Atomic.Repeat (out 0) (out 1) (out 2)

    (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 0) ∨
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 1) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
          ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 1).reset (v 0)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.atomic_repeated_triples
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (valuation : Fin 3 → Var → Role),
  (∀ (x : Var), KFOL.Atomic.Repeat (valuation 0 x) (valuation 1 x) (valuation 2 x)) →
    ∀ (out : Fin 3 → Role),
      (∀ (i : Fin 3),
          KFOL.Term.eval (fun x => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i x)) t = KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (out i)) →
        KFOL.Atomic.Repeat (out 0) (out 1) (out 2)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.binary_atom_preserving_iff
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (f : (Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (∃ t, t.IsCore ∧ t.AtomPreserving ∧ t.Idempotent ∧ ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.Term.eval v t = f v) ↔
    (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 0) ∨
      (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = v 1) ∨
        (∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 0).reset (v 1)) ∨
          ∀ (v : Fin 2 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role), f v = (v 1).reset (v 0)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.canonicalization_collapse
project_declarations.type:
∀ {K : ℕ} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Fin K) (canonicalize : KFOL.Problems.CoreTerm K → List Bool),
  KFOL.Problems.PolynomialTime canonicalize (KFOL.Problems.coreTermEncoding K) KFOL.Problems.wordEncoding →
    ∀ (compare : List Bool × List Bool → Bool),
      KFOL.Problems.PolynomialTime compare KFOL.Problems.pairWordEncoding KFOL.Problems.booleanEncoding →
        (∀ (s t : KFOL.Problems.CoreTerm K), compare (canonicalize s, canonicalize t) = true ↔ (↑s).Equivalent ↑t) →
          Cslib.Complexity.P KFOL.Problems.wordEncoding = Cslib.Complexity.NP KFOL.Problems.wordEncoding

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (owner : Role),

        ∀ (M : Type v) [inst : (KFOL.Equational.language KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol).Structure M],
          KFOL.Equational.InVariety KFOL.Dissemilattice.Symbol (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) M ↔
            Nonempty M ∧ KFOL.Dissemilattice.Laws KFOL.Dissemilattice.add KFOL.Dissemilattice.mul

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.common_source
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} {Index : Type w} (t : KFOL.Term Role Var)
  (valuation : Index → Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (regions : Index → Set Role),
  (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (regions i) (regions j)) →
    (∀ (i : Index), ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (valuation i) t) ⊆ regions i) →
      ∃ leaf p,
        (leaf, p) ∈ t.sourceOccurrences ∧
          (∀ (i : Index),
              ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.rename p (Sum.elim KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (valuation i) leaf)) ⊆ regions i) ∧
            ((∃ i j, i ≠ j) → ∃ x, leaf = Sum.inr x ∧ (x, p) ∈ t.inputOccurrences)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.congruence_classification
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
      ∃! c, KFOL.WinnerSet.AtomClosure c ∧ ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
    (∀ (c : ClosureOperator (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
        KFOL.WinnerSet.AtomClosure c → ∃ θ, ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), θ.toSetoid A B ↔ c A = c B) ∧
      (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.Congruence Role),
          ∃! F,
            KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F ∧
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B) ∧
        ∀ (F : Set (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)),
          KFOL.WinnerSet.AdmissibleFamily F →
            ∃ θ,
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F A = KFOL.WinnerSet.familyClosureValue F B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.expanded_nonfinite_basis
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [DecidableEq Role] [Finite Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (have x := KFOL.Equational.publicStructure Role;
    ¬KFOL.Equational.HasFiniteBasis (KFOL.Equational.PublicSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)) ∧
    (have x := KFOL.Equational.fullStructure Role;
      ¬KFOL.Equational.HasFiniteBasis (KFOL.Equational.FullSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∃ B full publicChoice,
          Nonempty B ∧
            Finite B ∧
              (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.FullSymbol Role)),
                  e.variableCount ≤ n →
                    (have x := KFOL.Equational.fullStructure Role;
                      e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)) →
                      e.Holds B) ∧
                (∀ (e : KFOL.Equational.Identity (KFOL.Equational.PublicSymbol Role)),
                    e.variableCount ≤ n →
                      (have x := KFOL.Equational.publicStructure Role;
                        e.Holds (KFOL.WinnerSet Role)) →
                        e.Holds B) ∧
                  (have x := KFOL.Equational.fullStructure Role;
                    ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.FullSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) B) ∧
                    have x := KFOL.Equational.publicStructure Role;
                    ¬KFOL.Equational.InVariety (KFOL.Equational.PublicSymbol Role) (KFOL.WinnerSet Role) B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.finite_depth_quantifier_reduction
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [Nontrivial Role] (depth : ℕ) (G : KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree Role),
  KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.DepthLE depth G →
    (∃ p, KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.IsSubgamePerfect p) ∧
      ∃ pruned binary,
        ∃ (pruning : KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.Prunes (Fintype.card Role - 1) G pruned),
          pruning.PreservesValues ∧
            KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.DepthLE depth pruned ∧
              pruned.Compiles binary ∧ KFOL.Strategic.possibleWinners binary = G.possibleWinners

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.guarded_choice_example
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        c ∉
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c)) ∧
          c ∈
            ↑(KFOL.WinnerSet.guardedChoice a ((KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton a).union (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b))
                (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton b) (KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton c))

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.idempotent_elimination
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
  (t.Idempotent ↔ ¬t.HasWinner ∧ ∀ (x : Var) (p : Equiv.Perm Role), (x, p) ∈ t.inputOccurrences → p = 1) ∧
    (t.Idempotent ↔ ∃ c, c.IsCore ∧ c.Equivalent t)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.infinite_winner_algebra
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        (∀ (n m : ℕ),
            KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners (KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c n m).value =
              if n < m then {a, b} else if n = m then {a, b, c} else {a, c}) ∧
          (∀ (n m : ℕ), (KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c n m).BooleanMenus) ∧
            ∀ (Carrier : Type w) [Finite Carrier], ¬Nonempty (KFOL.Rounds.Game.WinnerSummary a c Carrier)

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.intrinsic_player_views
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [inst : Fintype Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role Var),
      t.Idempotent →
        ∀ (k : Role) (valuation : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          KFOL.WinnerSet.view k (KFOL.Term.eval valuation t) =
            KFOL.PlayerView.eval three k t fun x => KFOL.WinnerSet.view k (valuation x)) ∧
    (Function.Injective fun A k => KFOL.WinnerSet.view k A) ∧
      (∀ (k : Role),
          Function.Surjective (KFOL.WinnerSet.view k) ∧ Nat.card (KFOL.PlayerView k) = Fintype.card Role + 1) ∧
        ∀ (k : Role),
          ∃ A B,
            A ≠ B ∧
              (∀ (j : Role), j ≠ k → KFOL.WinnerSet.view j A = KFOL.WinnerSet.view j B) ∧
                KFOL.WinnerSet.view k A ≠ KFOL.WinnerSet.view k B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.joint_owner_observation_failure
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∃ s t,
          KFOL.Owner.Term.OwnersIn (fun r => r = a ∨ r = b) s ∧
            KFOL.Owner.Term.OwnersIn (fun r => r = a ∨ r = b) t ∧
              (∀ (valuation : Fin 4 → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                  (a ∈ ↑(s.eval valuation) ↔ a ∈ ↑(t.eval valuation)) ∧
                    (b ∈ ↑(s.eval valuation) ↔ b ∈ ↑(t.eval valuation))) ∧
                ¬s.Equivalent t

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.minimum_reduct_test_domain
KFOL.Paper.neutral_union
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (r s t : Role),
  r ≠ s →
    r ≠ t →
      s ≠ t →
        ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          KFOL.WinnerSet.choice t (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice r A B) (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice s A B) = A.union B

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Paper.no_atomic_if_then_else
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (t : KFOL.Term Role (Fin 3)),
      ¬((∀ (y z : Role),
            KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (if i = 0 then a else if i = 1 then y else z)) t =
              KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton y) ∧
          ∀ (y z : Role),
            KFOL.Term.eval (fun i => KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton (if i = 0 then b else if i = 1 then y else z)) t =
              KFOL.WinnerSet.singleton z)

  [inst : (i : Index) → BooleanAlgebra (M i)] (select : Role → Index → Bool),

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [Finite Role] [inst : Nonempty Role] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role),
  (∀ (θ : KFOL.WinnerSet.SymmetricCongruence Role),
      ∃! m,
        ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) B) ∧
    (∀ (m : Fin (Nat.card Role)),
        ∃ θ,
          ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            θ.toSetoid A B ↔ KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (↑m) B) ∧
      Nat.card (KFOL.WinnerSet.SymmetricCongruence Role) = Nat.card Role ∧
        (∀ (m n : ℕ),
            m ≤ n →
              ∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold n A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold n B →
                  KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m A = KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m B) ∧
          (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold 0 A = KFOL.WinnerSet.full) ∧
            (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role), KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold (Nat.card Role - 1) A = A) ∧
              ∀ m < Nat.card Role,
                Nat.card (Quotient (Setoid.ker (KFOL.WinnerSet.threshold m))) =
                  1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, (Nat.card Role).choose j
